header_normalization: Trim, lowercase and replace whitespace/hyphen runs with underscore. Reject duplicate normalized headers and several headers mapping to one supported field.
text_normalization: NFC, collapse Unicode whitespace, trim; case-sensitive comparison. Raw supplied values are preserved in the rows-checked CSV.
character_counts: Unicode code points of normalized text, not graphemes or pixels. No minimum, maximum or Google truncation recommendation.
url_identity: Exact trimmed absolute HTTP(S) string, without credentials, whitespace or fragment markers. No fetching or cross-variant normalization.
duplicate_definition: Same nonempty normalized title/description across at least two distinct syntactically valid URL strings; invalid URL observations are retained but excluded from those groups. Repeated same-URL rows remain separate observations.
social_scope: Text inventory only. Even an og_image value is not fetched or validated as an image or HTTP response.
h1_comparison: UNKNOWN for absent H1 column, MISSING for blank H1 cell, UNKNOWN_TITLE_MISSING for absent title value, otherwise SAME or DIFFERENT_INFORMATIONAL. No rewrite prediction.
preview: One selectable supplied row; text nodes only; no input value becomes a clickable link or image. Illustrative formatting, not a live or device-specific Google result.
exports: Results CSV, findings CSV, report.md, input manifest and rows checked CSV (not a complete copy of the original input). Common formula-leading spreadsheet values are prefixed with an apostrophe in CSV copies.
blank_records: Blank CSV records are ignored. Counts and exports cover the remaining rows; the skipped-record count is not available.
result_rows: Result rows are numbered sequentially from 1. The header is not a result row. Result row numbers are not line numbers or original record positions in your input file.
